mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals economic peak and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP growth signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 growth increases for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals rising inflation pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment rates indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% during a monetary tightening cycle.
